property: At most one contender with the same pre-reservation ledger hash is accepted.

mapping.Acquire: Python os.mkdir of identity-ledger.json.lock; only a successful OS directory creation grants the reservation
mapping.Check: sha256_file ledger equals bound_ledger_sha256 after acquisition
mapping.Publish: jq staged append followed by mv temp_ledger ledger

assumptions: mkdir and same-directory rename are atomic
every writer honors this same lock
two contenders each uses the same initial hash and attempts once
mapping_recheck: Acquire uses the mkdir syscall result directly, preserving the model's exclusive acquisition on Ubuntu 26.04. The replay holds the winner inside Check until its peer has attempted acquisition and compares critical-section entry, process status and the published ledger record. The mutation removes Acquire and Release and must admit both contenders.
